description: Manual operator overrides (highest priority). Includes exceptional closures, early-close / late-open declarations, and corrections. A CONFIRMED override wins operationally but any conflict with an official record is surfaced, never hidden.

records.notes: Operator reported the market did not trade on 2026-08-27. The official sync could not be used to confirm it (both EGX sources returned ConnectionResetError) and the local feed had no heartbeat that day, so the closure rests on the operator's observation, not on measurement.
